name: NON-REFRIGERATED CENTRIFUGE
desc: Premium High-Speed Benchtop Microprocessor-Based Non-Refrigerated Laboratory Centrifuge. Features a heavy-duty brushless motor with electronic drive, a 4-line jumbo LCD display for real-time parameter recall, and programmable acceleration/deceleration profiles.
features: Dynamically Balanced Brushless Motor with Maintenance-Free Electronic Drive
Multi-Profile Storage system supporting up to 50 user-defined programs

specifications.Control System Layout: Microprocessor-Based System with User-Friendly Control Panel
specifications.Display Type Interface: Premium 4 Lines, 20 Characters Jumbo LCD Display screen
specifications.Monitored Parameters: Continuous tracking of Set/Run Time, Set/Run RPM, RCF, and Rotor ID
specifications.Parameter Tuning: Advanced Rotary Encoder-Based Fast Parameter Setting mechanism
specifications.Motor Drive Assembly: Dynamically Balanced Brushless Motor with Maintenance-Free Electronic Drive
specifications.Programmable Speed Range: 500 to 16000 RPM (Adjustable in precise intervals of 100 RPM)
specifications.Lid Safety Mechanism: Electronic Lid Lock (Prevents opening during run; auto-opens on stop)
specifications.Memory Capacity: Multi-Profile Storage system supporting up to 50 user-defined programs
specifications.Speed Profiles Control: Programmable Acceleration & Deceleration Time (15 to 200 Seconds range)
specifications.Braking & Safety: Intelligent Dynamic Automatic Brake with advanced Coast Feature
specifications.Digital Timer Range: Integrated digital timer adjustable from 0 to 99 Minutes
specifications.Internal Chamber Material: Heavy-Gauge Stainless Steel 304 Grade Rust-Free Centrifugal Bowl
specifications.Outer Enclosure Material: Heavy-Duty Cold Rolled Close (C.R.C.) Steel Finish with Powder Coating
specifications.Operation Mechanics: Soft Suspension System for smooth, stable, and noiseless operation
specifications.Internal Power Electronics: Integrated Delta (Taiwan) VFD and Stabilized SMPS system
specifications.Warranty Support: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty against manufacturing defects
